narration:6:1760010006:1.text: There, they run into two chubby familiars...

say:11:1760010008:1.text: Are you a Digimon? I've never seen one like you before.
say:11:1760010008:1.source_cn: 是从没见过的数码宝贝。

say:13:1760010010:1.text: Wow, are you a unicorn like Sonny?
say:13:1760010010:1.source_cn: 哇，你是和桑尼一样的独角兽吗？

say:17:1760010012:1.text: You can talk? Are you familiars, just like us?
say:17:1760010012:1.source_cn: 你们也会说话吗？唔，难道也是使魔……

say:18:1760010013:0.text: I wonder what you'll look like after Digivolving!
say:18:1760010013:0.source_cn: 你们进化后会是什么样子呢？

say:21:1760010015:1.text: At that time, Taichi and Yamato also arrive at the lakeside.
say:21:1760010015:1.source_cn: 这时，太一和大和也抵达了湖畔。

say:33:1760010021:1.female: Magister, Chippy missed you so much! *Sobbing*

say:34:1760010022:1.text: Silly Chippy, didn't we agree not to cry? You'll make the Magister worry!
say:34:1760010022:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，不是说好不要哭吗？会让梅林担心的！

say:39:1760010025:1.text: *Sigh* I wish you wouldn't push yourself so hard...

say:51:1760010031:1.text: Wow, what an epic journey you've had! That's so cool!
say:51:1760010031:1.source_cn: 哇，原来你们经历过那么多冒险！好厉害！

say:54:1760010032:1.text: Digital World... Sounds like a unique place! What about Esperia? Do you like it here?
say:54:1760010032:1.source_cn: 数码世界……感觉和伊索米亚大陆是完全不同的地方呢！你们...

say:55:1760010033:0.text: Esperia's a lovely place! The scenery is beautiful, and there's so much delicious food and so many interesting cultures. Right, Agumon?
say:55:1760010033:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们很喜欢这里！景色很美，还有很多美食和有趣的风俗...

say:56:1760010034:0.text: Mmm... exactly! I'm a big fan of this pancake!
say:56:1760010034:0.source_cn: 唔唔……没错！尤其是这个烤松饼，好好吃哦……

say:61:1760010035:0.text: I feel the same way. More than anything, the people here are very kind.
say:61:1760010035:0.source_cn: 我也赞同。最重要的是，这里的人们都很友善。

say:62:1760010036:0.text: Yeah... It's been so long since we could just enjoy a carefree moment like this.
say:62:1760010036:0.source_cn: 是啊，很久没有享受这样宁静悠闲的时光了。

say:65:1760010037:1.text: Are you nervous about going back?
say:65:1760010037:1.source_cn: 那你们会不会害怕回去？

say:66:1760010038:1.text: The Magister said you'll have to face the dreadful Dark Masters once you return...
say:66:1760010038:1.source_cn: 听主人说，你们一旦回去，就必须要面对黑暗四天王带来的生...
say:66:1760010038:1.male: The Magister said you'll have to face the dreadful Dark Masters once you return...
say:66:1760010038:1.female: The Magister said you'll have to face the dreadful Dark Masters once you return...

say:70:1760010039:0.text: Yes, our mission is a dangerous one.
say:70:1760010039:0.source_cn: 是啊，我们要做的事确实充满了危险。

say:71:1760010040:0.text: But Chippy, you know what? Before the Dark Masters took over, the Digital World was just as beautiful and full of hope as Esperia.
say:71:1760010040:0.source_cn: 但是，满满，你知道吗？在被黑暗四天王占领前，数码世界也...

say:72:1760010041:0.text: That's why, when I look at this world, I feel it more strongly than ever. We're the ones who have to take back peace in the Digital World.
say:72:1760010041:0.source_cn: 我们珍惜在伊索米亚冒险的这段时光，是因为它能让我们看到...

say:76:1760010042:0.text: If anything, I'm more determined to return to the Digital World...
say:76:1760010042:0.source_cn: 嗯，这段日子让我重新下定决心，要回到数码世界与同伴们团聚。

say:77:1760010043:1.text: We simply have to—for the sake of our family, our friends, the Digimon who have helped us, and ourselves.
say:77:1760010043:1.source_cn: 为了家人、朋友，为了不辜负那些帮助我们的数码宝贝，为了...

say:78:1760010044:1.text: I want to do my part to bring peace back to the world of us and Gabumon and the others..
say:78:1760010044:1.source_cn: 我希望能通过自身的努力，让我们的世界、加布兽和亚古兽的...

say:82:1760010046:0.text: Taichi, I believe we can do it!
say:82:1760010046:0.source_cn: 太一，我相信我们一定能够做到！

say:83:1760010047:0.text: Yeah! We have to go back and face the Dark Masters! It's up to us to secure a bright future for everyone!
say:83:1760010047:0.source_cn: 嗯！所以，我们必须回去，打败黑暗四天王，让大家都能过上...

say:84:1760010048:1.text: Once we've rested, let's go seek out that Hypofiend!
say:84:1760010048:1.source_cn: 各位，修整完毕后，我们就出发寻找那只强大的魔物吧！
